description: Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a beloved street food snack, featuring a fluffy bread exterior deeply cut into wedges and filled with a sweet, tangy cream cheese mixture. Each segment is then generously drenched in a rich, buttery garlic sauce, creating an irresistible blend of savory, sweet, and aromatic flavors. This unique bread offers a delightful contrast of textures and tastes, making it a truly addictive treat.

ingredients.item: Round Milk Bread or Brioche Bun

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Take the round bread and make deep cuts across the top, creating 6 or 8 equal wedges, but do not cut all the way through the bottom. The cuts should allow the bread to open up like a flower.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar, and 2 tablespoons of heavy cream. Mix until the filling is smooth and creamy with no lumps. Transfer this mixture into a piping bag or a zip-top bag with a corner snipped off.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Sauce
instructions.text: In another bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, chopped fresh parsley, 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar, whole milk, egg yolk, and salt. Mix well until all ingredients are thoroughly combined.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully open each wedge of the cut bread and generously pipe the cream cheese filling into the crevices. Ensure an even distribution of the filling throughout all the cuts. You want each segment to be plump with the sweet cream cheese.

instructions.title: Drench in Garlic Butter Sauce
instructions.text: Place the filled bread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Using a spoon or a brush, thoroughly drench the entire bread, especially the cream cheese-filled crevices, with the garlic butter sauce. Make sure every part is coated for maximum flavor.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the cream cheese is slightly melted and warm, and the garlic butter sauce has seeped into the bread, creating a fragrant and delicious crust. Serve immediately while warm.

tips: For the best texture, use a soft, fluffy milk bread or brioche bun. If unavailable, a good quality challah bread can be a decent substitute.
Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing to achieve a smooth, lump-free filling. You can gently warm it in a microwave for a few seconds if needed.
Do not overbake the bread; it should be golden brown and fragrant, not dry. The inside should remain soft and moist from the cream cheese and garlic butter.
